description:
Track and evaluate the performance of your investment portfolio across stocks, cryptocurrencies, and other assets.


* New: Trades can now be grouped by lot: each purchase creates its own trade, and sales are split across the lots they close.
* New: Categories in the statement of assets can be collapsed and expanded; the collapsed state is remembered per file and taxonomy.
* New: The line width in the historical price chart can now be set to 1, 2, or 3 pixels via the chart menu.
* Improvement: Enhanced PDF importers for Barclays Bank Ireland, comdirect, Consorsbank, DAB, Raiffeisen Bankengruppe, and Trade Republic.
* Improvement: The title of the Trades view now reflects the selected accounts and portfolios.
* Fix: Importing a large number of PDF documents no longer fails with a "No more handles" error.
* Fix: Searching for a new instrument no longer aborts with an error when a search provider returns an unexpected answer.
* Fix: Trades now use the exchange rate recorded on the transaction instead of the daily rate.
* Fix: Fixed a sporadic error in the portfolio balance chart when it was updated twice in quick succession.
* Fix: The donut chart now sorts consistently with the pie chart.
